clauses.why: "his field" and "nearer" aside, the verses give his command to let her glean among the sheaves and not reproach her; the first citation adds detail not needed.
clauses.english: commanded his young men to let Ruth glean and not to reproach her
clauses.ukr: наказав своїм слугам дозволити Рут збирати і не кривдити її
clauses.deu: gebot seinen Knechten, Ruth lesen zu lassen und sie nicht zu beschämen
clauses.spa: mandó a sus criados que dejaran a Ruth coger espigas y que no la avergonzaran

clauses.why: The verses say "all that was Elimelech's", not land, and the kinsman told him to buy it; "nearer" and "redeem" are not stated.
clauses.english: bought all that was Elimelech's from Naomi after the kinsman told him to buy it
clauses.ukr: набув усе, що було Елімелехове, з руки Ноомі, після того як родич сказав йому купити це
clauses.deu: kaufte alles, was dem Elimelech gehört hatte, von der Hand Naemis, nachdem der Erbe ihm gesagt hatte, er solle es kaufen
clauses.spa: tomó todo lo que fue de Elimelech de mano de Noemi, después de que el pariente le dijo que lo tomara

clauses.why: "the Moabitess" is not in the cited verse.
clauses.english: took Ruth as his wife, and she bore a son
clauses.ukr: взяв Рут собі за жінку, і вона породила сина
clauses.deu: nahm Ruth zur Frau, und sie gebar einen Sohn
clauses.spa: tomó a Ruth por mujer, y ella parió un hijo
